requirements.statement: Ariadne shall read and change only data belonging to the user represented by the authenticated principal, and shall reject attempts to add authority through a user ID in the input or embedded instructions.
When an input-saving request is received, Ariadne shall persist the original input and processing status, and shall return the save result separately from the structuring result.

When a structural change is requested, Ariadne shall validate references within the same user, self-references, parent-child and dependency cycles, and revisions; if validation fails, it shall apply no changes.
While an unfinished task or any of its ancestors has a future Defer time, Ariadne shall exclude it from the normal list and show the reason and individual times in the deferred list.
When a list is requested at or after a Defer time, Ariadne shall return a projection in which that Defer has expired, without changing completion, due dates, or individual Defer values.
When resolving a date-only Defer time, Ariadne shall display the concrete 09:00 time in the configured IANA time zone and preserve the resulting instant after saving, even if settings later change.
Before saving a Defer, Ariadne shall show the scope affected by a parent and any earlier due date, and shall indicate that a current or past time will not hide the task.

While a prerequisite is unfinished or waiting on another person remains unresolved, Ariadne shall show the dependency reason and shall not clear an individual Defer merely because the dependency is resolved.
When asked to complete a parent, Ariadne shall reject the request if descendants remain unfinished, and shall not complete the parent automatically when all descendants are complete.
When reopening a task, Ariadne shall preserve its saved Defer and, if an ancestor is complete, shall reopen the confirmed scope at the same time.

When an undo is requested, Ariadne shall compare the applied version of affected items with their current versions, shall not roll back later corrections, and shall preserve relationship invariants after the inverse operation.
When a request with the same operationId is received again, Ariadne shall return the saved result for identical content, reject different content, and make no duplicate business change.
When a change request targets stale state, Ariadne shall report a conflict and provide a way to retrieve the latest state.
When the UI is shown, refreshed, or finishes a change, Ariadne shall display the latest list and retrieval time, and distinguish save failure, unknown outcome, and pending judgment from success.
When a conflict or refresh occurs, the UI shall retain dirty drafts for comparison with the latest values and shall not overwrite them before explicit discard or save.

boundaries.contract: Obtain the principal through the existing Sites/Plugin authentication boundary. Reject owner input. Authentication acceptance is out of scope for this change.
Use a shared command envelope and preview/apply/status/undo operations. Unify the source of truth for conversation and UI.
GraphSnapshot + Command + now → ChangeSet. Independent of D1, HTTP, and LLM.
Atomically save per-user revision CAS, business diffs, immutable receipts, and history in a D1 batch.
GraphSnapshot + now → normal/deferred/completed projections and all waiting/Defer reasons.
Continue using the existing Sites /mcp and versioned MCP Apps resource/bridge.
Separate snapshot from dirty drafts. Preserve operationId and payload when the outcome is unknown.

nonfunctional_requirements.contract: Sites request processing. Defer correctness must not depend on a scheduler or background processing.
Per-user revisions, bounded retries, and complete snapshots.
Verify complete lists, retrieval time, and unknown outcomes in Work. Cost and infrastructure performance are out of scope.
Preserve existing server identity and owner constraints. Do not include secrets in UI or routine logs. Authentication acceptance is out of scope.
Manage schemaVersion and versioned UI; explicitly reject changes from unknown versions.
